faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by PDPM Indian Institute of Information Technology Design and Manufacturing Jabalpur (IIITDM Jabalpur) for a project-based research position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this vacancy?
faq.answer: The available post name is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under an ANRF-PMECRG sponsored project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in IIITDM Jabalpur recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 05-10-2026. Candidates must apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month + HRA as per Institute norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess B.E./B.Tech with M.E./M.Tech or equivalent in CSE/IT or related discipline with a valid GATE/NET qualification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Please check official guidelines for any applicable age relaxation.

faq.question: Q8. When is the scheduled date for the test or interview?
faq.answer: The date of the test or interview for shortlisted candidates is scheduled for 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. How can candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply by filling out the online Google application form provided in the official notification details.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for IIITDM Jabalpur JRF?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the screening of applications followed by an Online/Offline Interview of shortlisted candidates.
